correctness.rationale: Uniform BST leaf count equals the number of strict cyclic maxima in a random priority sequence with one adjoined minimum. For the s-th cumulant the only contributing connected indicator clusters on the N-cycle with N>=2s+1 have one long gap, so each cluster has N translates and kappa_s(L_m)=(m+1)c_s for m>=2s. Independent left/right conditional BSTs of sizes a,b then give (n+1)c_s for all s<=r and a,b>=2r. The independent-path event yields exactly P(L_n=2|J=a+1)=2^(n-3)/(a!b!), strictly varying with imbalance. Identical means and unequal laws exclude first-order stochastic domination. n>=4r+3 supplies at least two distinct unordered eligible splits. No sharp cutoff assertion.
